messages:
Alex K: CI red on main — flaky failure in timer_coalesce_test. Happens ~1/50 runs on macos-12 runner. seed=8421 in the log. Can someone triage or kick a rerun?

ci-bot: Build #4821 (main): FAILED — 1 failed test. Link: https://ci.redwood.dev/4821 (logs attached) :x:

Alex K: failing snippet:```
thread 'timer_coalesce_test' panicked at 'assertion failed: remaining_timers == 0 (found 1)', runtime/src/timer.rs:214:10
seed: 8421
stack backtrace omitted for brevity
```

Maya R: ugh. Is this the one that flakes on epoch boundaries? any repro locally with the seed?

Alex K: repro command i ran: `RUST_TEST_THREADS=1 SEED=8421 cargo test -p runtime timer_coalesce_test -- --nocapture` — sometimes passes locally, sometimes fails after ~30 runs. env: macOS 12, rust 1.70.0.

Jordan: timer coalescing is timing-sensitive. Might be scheduler jitter. Can you paste the exact failing log around the timer queue processing? also which allocator (jemalloc/system)?

Alex K: allocator=system. extended log:```
[INFO] timer: processing 3 timers at t=1612345678
[DEBUG] timer: coalesced next_wake=50ms, scheduled 1
[WARN] timer: expired timers count mismatch expected=0 actual=1
panic at assertion
```

Sam B: I can run a binary bisect across the last 40 commits. @Alex K — can you point me at the commit range that CI used? ci-bot linked commit 9f3b2a4 -> main head. I'll start with that range and report a minimal commit if found.

Maya R: quick try: can we add a tiny stabilization wait in the test (sleep 1ms) to see if it's purely a race? if that fixes it, we should still bisect upstream cause we don't want to paper over it.

Alex K: willing to try. I'll push a small debug patch with an optional env var `TEST_TIMER_STABILIZE=1` that sleeps 1ms before final assert. if that reduces flakes on CI we can use it as short-term.

ci-bot: Rerun requested by Alex K — queued as #4822.

Sam B: started bisect job locally: `./scripts/bisect-tests --range 9f3b2a4..HEAD --test timer_coalesce_test --seed 8421` — will post if I find a commit that increases failure rate. ETA ~30m.

Maya R: thanks. @Sam B please also try with `RUST_TEST_THREADS=1` and with ASAN off to match CI.

Alex K: noted. If bisect surfaces anything suspicious (scheduler or timer refactor), we'll decide on revert vs fix. ping me here with results or if you need extra logs. thx :pray:

Jordan: if it keeps being nondet, we should consider converting that assert into a retry loop in the test with a short timeout and log for debugging — better than flaky CI.

Sam B: first bisect pass found increased failure rate starting at commit 3c7e1f9 (timer coalesce refactor). digging into that commit now. will follow up.

Maya R: great, when you have a suspect diff I can run focused local fuzzing. also opened an internal issue RDW-1284 to track the triage.

Alex K: thanks team — leaving the debug patch PR draft up (WIP) at https://git.redwood.dev/runtime/pulls/133 until we decide.
